vote_id.description: your id for this vote; binds permanently to this vote once drafted

last_write.message: vote_id accept-1 is bound to a different vote (space, proposal, choice or reason differ); use a new vote_id

rules.approval: a write that needs the owner returns -3 'approval pending (<id>)'. Before approving, the owner runs the verify commands in votes/<vote_id>.json and checks that Bloom's hash equals the ceremony's exact hash; after approving, retry the exact same write promptly (the approval window is 5 minutes).
rules.binding: a vote_id binds permanently to (network, account, space, proposal, choice, reason) and the frozen typed data once drafted. The identical body resumes from the current state; a different body under a bound vote_id is refused (-3). A refused vote_id is not bound: a corrected body may reuse it.
rules.body: JSON object, at most 4096 bytes, unknown fields refused; reason at most 500 characters (missing = ""); vote_id "new" is reserved
rules.checks_before_signing: the proposal exists on this network and belongs to space; it is active and now < end; type single-choice or basic; 1 <= choice <= number of choices; the account has voting power. Each failure is recorded as refused with a reason_code.
rules.completion: a successful write means the handler finished: status submitted means the Snapshot sequencer accepted the vote; counted means the hub shows it. Read votes/<vote_id>.json.
rules.expiry: expired (proposal_closed, timestamp_stale, approval_expired) and rejected_by_snapshot are final: write a new vote_id to vote again.
rules.mainnet: mainnet votes are disabled in this build (refused as mainnet_disabled).
rules.read_after_write: every write, including mounted (asynchronous) ones, updates last_write below; compare its body_sha256 with sha256 of your body.
